our_inference: H2 must distinguish cancellation before admission from custody of already-started effects, and successful authority-dependent recovery from process exit/registry drain. This changes the future failure criteria, not current runtime confidence.
next_falsifiable_gate: Pin authentic adjacent packaged Gateway runtimes and complete lifecycle/session/provider dependencies. Hold both coordinator and session admission, then cancel before provider entry; independently verify bounded settlement, zero provider/write entry and unchanged durable provisioning. Contrast already-started provider/write work: retain exact FIFO/lease ownership until actual settlement, reject late writes/reordered successors, and measure logical abort, run-registry drain, finalizer drain, provider/OS exit and authority restoration separately under preregistered monotonic deadlines. Fence new entry while retaining the admitted binding through cleanup; test shutdown during held finalizers and deduplicated recovery with a later caller's cancellation. Independently boot twice with interrupted peer, stream and yielded-parent wake, current device/role authority, exact durable identities and healthy/refused/revoked-authority controls. A clean exit/empty registry or operator_authority_unavailable does not satisfy successful parent-wake recovery. Missing/mismatched effects, lost FIFO/custody, unauthorized continuation or a missed bound falsifies the corresponding claim. Freeze matched-host baseline/candidate timing and negative controls before any speed claim. Proposed only; no local experiment released.
